titulo: Why Spiders "Invade" Your House Every Fall (They Don't)
titulos_alternativos: The Spiders in Your House Didn't Come From Outside
Never Put a House Spider Outside. Here's Why
descripcion:
Every fall, big spiders suddenly show up on the floor and in the bathtub, and everybody says the same thing: it's getting cold, so they're coming inside. That story is wrong. Those spiders have been living in your house the whole time.

In this video: why spiders don't care about warmth, why house spiders are a different crowd from the ones in your garden, who the spider running across your carpet really is, how he ended up stuck in your bathtub, and why carrying a house spider outside usually doesn't save it.
